<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="390" height="844" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="3" stdDeviation="8" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.08"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Android status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height=" thirty" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="20" y="19" font-family="Roboto" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#1F1E29">9:41</text>
  <line x1="327" y1="14" x2="327" y2="18" stroke="#1F1E29" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="331" y1="12" x2="331" y2="18" stroke="#1F1E29" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="335" y1="10" x2="335" y2="18" stroke="#1F1E29" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="348" cy="16" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#1F1E29" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="345" y1="13" x2="351" y2="19" stroke="#1F1E29" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <rect x="362" y="10" width="20" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#1F1E29" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="364" y="12" width="14" height="7" rx="1" fill="#7A1851"/>
  <rect x="383" y="13" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#1F1E29"/>

  <!-- Header -->
  <line x1="0" y1=" thirty" x2="390" y2=" thirty" stroke="#EBEBEB" stroke-width="1"/>
  <polyline points="31,57 23,65 31,73" fill="none" stroke="#1F1E29" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="52" y="70" font-family="Roboto" font-size="20" font-weight="500" fill="#1F1E29">Check-in</text>
  <circle cx="356" cy="64" r="17" fill="#FFD3D1"/>
  <circle cx="356" cy="59" r="4.5" fill="#7A1851"/>
  <ellipse cx="356" cy="70" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#7A1851"/>

  <!-- Progress -->
  <text x="24" y="105" font-family="Roboto" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#7A1851">STEP 1 OF 3</text>
  <text x="366" y="105" text-anchor="end" font-family="Roboto" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">Passengers</text>
  <rect x="24" y="114" width="342" height="6" rx="3" fill="#EBEBEB"/>
  <rect x="24" y="114" width="114" height="6" rx="3" fill="#DB6186"/>

  <text x="24" y="157" font-family="Roboto" font-size="30" font-weight="600" fill="#1F1E29">Review passengers</text>
  <text x="24" y="182" font-family="Roboto" font-size="15" font-weight="400" fill="#5F5E65">Check that everyone is ready to fly.</text>

  <!-- Flight card -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="24" y="202" width="342" height="111" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <rect x="24" y="202" width="342" height="111" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#EBEBEB" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="43" y="226" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#949499">YOUR FLIGHT</text>
  <text x="43" y="253" font-family="Roboto" font-size="18" font-weight="600" fill="#1F1E29">London</text>
  <text x="43" y="274" font-family="Roboto" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#5F5E65">LHR  ·  18 Jun 2026</text>
  <line x1="157" y1="258" x2="233" y2="258" stroke="#DB6186" stroke-width="2"/>
  <polygon points="230,253 241,258 230,263" fill="#DB6186"/>
  <circle cx="157" cy="258" r="4" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DB6186" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="255" y="253" font-family="Roboto" font-size="18" font-weight="600" fill="#1F1E29">Lisbon</text>
  <text x="255" y="274" font-family="Roboto" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#5F5E65">LIS  ·  TP1367</text>
  <rect x="43" y="286" width="77" height="17" rx="8" fill="#FFD3D1"/>
  <text x="81" y="298" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#7A1851">ECONOMY</text>
  <text x="346" y="298" text-anchor="end" font-family="Roboto" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">09:25 – 12:05</text>

  <!-- Section header -->
  <text x="24" y="350" font-family="Roboto" font-size="20" font-weight="600" fill="#1F1E29">Passengers</text>
  <text x="366" y="350" text-anchor="end" font-family="Roboto" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#DB6186">2 travellers</text>

  <!-- Passenger 1 -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="24" y="370" width="342" height="82" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <rect x="24" y="370" width="342" height="82" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#EBEBEB" stroke-width="1"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="411" r="22" fill="#FFD3D1"/>
  <text x="55" y="417" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#7A1851">JM</text>
  <text x="91" y="401" font-family="Roboto" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#1F1E29">James Miller</text>
  <text x="91" y="423" font-family="Roboto" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">Adult  ·  Seat 14A</text>
  <rect x="270" y="399" width="76" height="24" rx="12" fill="#FFD3D1"/>
  <polyline points="281,411 285,415 292,407" fill="none" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="312" y="415" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#7A1851">Ready</text>

  <!-- Passenger 2 -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="24" y="464" width="342" height="82" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <rect x="24" y="464" width="342" height="82" rx="13" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#EBEBEB" stroke-width="1"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="505" r="22" fill="#FFB7B8"/>
  <text x="55" y="511" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#7A1851">SM</text>
  <text x="91" y="495" font-family="Roboto" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#1F1E29">Sophie Miller</text>
  <text x="91" y="517" font-family="Roboto" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">Adult  ·  Seat 14B</text>
  <rect x="270" y="493" width="76" height="24" rx="12" fill="#FFD3D1"/>
  <polyline points="281,505 285,509 292,501" fill="none" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="312" y="509" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#7A1851">Ready</text>

  <line x1="24" y1="568" x2="366" y2="568" stroke="#EBEBEB" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="24" y="597" font-family="Roboto" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#1F1E29">Need to make a change?</text>
  <text x="24" y="619" font-family="Roboto" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#5F5E65">You can update passenger details before continuing.</text>

  <!-- Secondary button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="638" width="155" height="43" rx="22" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#DB6186" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="101.5" y="665" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#7A1851">Edit details</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Primary button -->
  <g>
    <rect x="191" y="638" width="175" height="43" rx="22" fill="#7A1851"/>
    <text x="278.5" y="665" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="14" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Continue</text>
    <polyline points="336,657 341,661.5 336,666" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="724" width="390" height="120" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="724" x2="390" y2="724" stroke="#EBEBEB" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="39,759 50,750 61,759 61,772 54,772 54,764 46,764 46,772 39,772" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="50" y="795" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="127" cy="758" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="127" y1="752" x2="127" y2="764" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="121" y1="758" x2="133" y2="758" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="127" y="795" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">Bookings</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="185" y="749" width="25" height="20" rx="4" fill="#FFD3D1"/>
    <polygon points="185,754 178,750 178,766 185,763" fill="#FFD3D1"/>
    <line x1="191" y1="755" x2="204" y2="755" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="191" y1="761" x2="201" y2="761" stroke="#7A1851" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="197" y="795" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#7A1851">Check-in</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="308" cy="754" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <ellipse cx="308" cy="768" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#949499" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="308" y="795" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Roboto" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#949499">Account</text>
  </g>
</svg>
